_comment: Copy this file to machine.json (same folder) and edit for this machine. machine.json is git-ignored.
_browse_roots: Folders the study desk (scripts/study_desk.py) may list when you pick cases and .sub/.con/.mon files. Default: the folder that holds this repo.
_research_files_root: Where study-area research documents live (task 29). Empty = research/areas/<AREA>/files in the repo (git-ignored, this machine only). Set it to a synced folder, e.g. C:\Users\<you>\OneDrive\TARA Research, to have the same documents on every machine; summaries and digests travel with git.
